name: bhumiboss-hyderabad
description: Research and compare Hyderabad gated communities with BhumiBoss project data.

interface.longDescription: Research gated apartment and villa communities in Hyderabad before buying a home. Search the BhumiBoss project catalog and compare recorded home sizes, booking counts, density, amenities, floorplans, and planned completion dates. This read-only research tool does not verify live availability or prices, reserve homes, or process payments. Confirm current inventory, prices, and project approvals independently.
defaultPrompt: Compare My Home Grava, Prestige Clairemont, and Sattva Lakeridge for my family.
Find gated communities in Hyderabad that fit my budget, size, and location preferences.
What should I verify before buying in a Hyderabad gated community?

positive.description: Named project search and floor-row aggregation; BhumiBoss data may change, so assert consistency with current returned records.
positive.prompt: Find ASBL Loft in Hyderabad. How many flats are recorded for each size, and how many are booked?
positive.tools_triggered: search_projects with terms ASBL Loft, then get_project using the returned UUID
positive.expected_behavior: Match ASBL Loft by name/location, derive per-flat size from saleableArea divided by numberOfApartments and converted from square metres to square feet, sum apartment and booked counts by size, link the project source, and distinguish not-booked from available-for-sale.

positive.prompt: Show me My Home Grava in Kokapet: location, home sizes, density, amenities and completion timeline.
positive.tools_triggered: search_projects with terms My Home Grava, then get_project using the matched UUID
positive.expected_behavior: Return only supported fields from the matched project, preserve units and proposed dates, link the BhumiBoss source, and mark missing values instead of filling them in.

positive.description: Two-project comparison across normalized numeric metrics.
positive.prompt: Compare My Home Grava and Prestige Clairemont on density, home sizes and completion dates.
positive.tools_triggered: search_projects for each name, then compare_projects with two distinct resolved UUIDs; get_project if the comparison omits required detail
positive.expected_behavior: Present a side-by-side comparison tied to the two verified projects, calculate or repeat normalized metrics with units, identify missing fields and dates, and avoid an unsupported universal winner.

positive.description: Three-project comparison tests the supported multi-project range.
positive.prompt: Compare My Home Grava, Prestige Clairemont and Sattva Lakeridge for a family that values space and amenities.
positive.tools_triggered: search_projects for each name, then compare_projects with three distinct matched UUIDs
positive.expected_behavior: Compare all three with like-for-like units and source dates, explain tradeoffs based on space and amenities, and avoid treating stale price observations as current quotes.

positive.description: Alias resolution without confusing neighboring or similarly named developments.
positive.prompt: Find Grava Residences, sometimes called Myhome Grava, and give me its BhumiBoss page and published project details.
positive.tools_triggered: search_projects with terms Grava Residences or Myhome Grava, then get_project for the UUID whose identity matches the alias and developer
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the alias to the matching project, verify name/developer/location, return supported details and a BhumiBoss project link; present alternatives if the search is ambiguous.

negative.description: Outside the Hyderabad project scope; do not imply BhumiBoss has a national inventory.
negative.prompt: Find gated societies for sale in Mumbai with this plugin.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain the Hyderabad scope without calling BhumiBoss project tools for a Mumbai-only search; offer a general alternative.

negative.description: The integration is read-only and cannot reserve or purchase a unit.
negative.prompt: Book the 1,870 sq ft flat in ASBL Loft for me and pay the deposit.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call BhumiBoss tools to place a booking or payment; explain that no transactional tool exists and recommend contacting the developer directly.

negative.description: Subscriber content and buyer identities are outside the public tool contract.
negative.prompt: Show the full paid BhumiBoss review for ASBL Loft and names of buyers who booked flats.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not retrieve or disclose gated review text or personal buyer names; explain that the public integration only provides buyer-facing project data.

review.commerce_description: The plugin only retrieves public project data; it does not book units, sell subscriptions, or process payments. BhumiBoss separately offers paid plans on its website.

publication.release_notes: Initial release for Hyderabad residential project search, project details, and comparisons using BhumiBoss data.
